tiles.ownership: 纯躯干，移除原贴图内附着的大腿

limitations: Pixel ownership is determined from alpha connectivity, not anatomical identity.
Low-alpha pixels within the padding envelope use nearest component ownership; ties are assigned deterministically.
Detached details beyond the padding envelope require explicit source registration.
